affiliate.title: Referrals
affiliate.intro: Invite writers and readers to Literary Universe with your referral link.
affiliate.disabled: New referrals are not enabled for your account. Any past referrals remain in your totals.
affiliate.signups: {count, plural, one {# verified signup} other {# verified signups}}
affiliate.refunded: {count, plural, one {# fully refunded conversion excluded} other {# fully refunded conversions excluded}}
affiliate.cutoff: A referral counts as a conversion when their first personal subscription payment is made within one year of signup. Free trials, gifts and organization access do not count. These figures are not a payout statement.
affiliate.error: We could not load or copy your referral information. Please try again.
affiliate.adminError: The change could not be completed. Check the user IDs and your permissions, then try again.
affiliate.ownerHelp: Set an owner ID only for a marketer or employee. Leave it empty for other referrers. Existing HubSpot assignments are preserved.
affiliate.notConfigured: HubSpot sync is not configured on this server.
